question: What is the primary objective of the Subhadra Yojana launched by Odisha Government?

options.text: To provide housing amenities to women
To give financial assistance of Rs. 50000 over five years to women aged 21-60
To offer educational scholarships to female students
To support women entrepreneurs with loans

solution:
The correct answer is __**To give financial assistance of Rs. 50000 over five years to women aged 21-60**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Subhadra Yojana** was launched by the **Odisha Government** with the aim of providing financial assistance to women.
 
• This scheme offers a financial benefit of **Rs. 50,000** over a period of **five years** to eligible women.
 
• The beneficiaries of the scheme are women aged **21 to 60 years**, ensuring support during their productive years.
 
• The initiative is targeted at **empowering women** financially and improving their quality of life.
 
• The scheme is part of the state's broader efforts to promote **women's welfare** and **economic independence**.
